g.text: Each box sits on three separate networks:
03 §3.1 · the active home's F1, one unit
client racks and cloud on-ramps: 2 cross-connects per client,
one to CA and one to CB, cut to equal fibre length
dark fibre to F2 … Fn: three separate fibre sets on separate routes
PTP (L2 multicast, its own VLAN on each switch)
CA · CB · RA · RB · DX → the PHC of every NIC
BMCs, serial consoles, PDUs, the switches' management ports, admin box.
Its own carrier uplink. No production VLAN touches it.
